_about: Local basemaps for the Route tab helicopter view: simplified OpenStreetMap vector data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, openstreetmap.org/copyright - coastline / water bodies, rivers + canals, motorway / trunk / primary roads + runways, parks / nature reserves / large forest. Coordinates are km east / north of each area's lat / lon. Bundled; never fetched at runtime.
